Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J27/J27nB193.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yinyuan (隱元禪師語錄): Yinyuan Longqi: Yinyuan Longqi calls the unseeing crowd that follows Yunmen’s “exposed” answer blind donkeys.

Senses.Explanation: A blind donkey is also a cutting label for a person judged to follow without seeing. Linji Yixuan applies it to Sansheng Huiran in the succession exchange: ‘Who knew my true teaching eye would perish beside this blind donkey?’ Yuanwu Keqin uses Linji’s line as a test; Feiyin Tongrong raises the old exchange; and Ma Fang adapts it in his preface to Linji’s record. Mi’an Xianjie extends the label to a whole rank that loses the living operation, while Yinyuan Longqi applies it to people merely following Yunmen’s exposed answer.
